requirements.description: Must provide normalized REST APIs with OAuth2 authentication
Vector search and retrieval must enforce tenant data segregation
System must support role-based access control and detailed audit logging

generated_response.executive_summary: Lunetron is pleased to provide this proposal response. Our platform provides enterprise-grade normalized REST APIs, strict tenant vector segregation, and end-to-end auditability.
generated_response.draft_email_body:
Dear Procurement Lead,

Thank you for sharing your enterprise RFP specification. Lunetron is fully equipped to meet your integration and security requirements.

Our system exposes standards-compliant REST endpoints secured via OAuth2, guarantees strict tenant vector segregation, and maintains complete append-only audit logs.

We welcome the opportunity to discuss next steps.

Sincerely,
Lunetron Proposal Team

requirement_responses.response: Lunetron exposes standards-compliant REST endpoints secured via OAuth2 bearer tokens.
Lunetron strictly enforces tenant isolation across all relational tables and vector searches using immutable company_id scoping.
